overview_description.description: YallaDoc platform gives a reliable updated directory of healthcare providers to conveniently choose and book doctors based on reviews, Insurance, location, and availability. YallaDoc is focused on Mom and Baby and it is starting from pediatrics specialty. The solutions that Yalladoc is offering will help cover the visibility, knowledge convenience, and trust gap that patients are currently suffering from. It will also help healthcare providers improve their efficiency in managing bookings, marketing, and patients satisfaction. The platform has also another vertical that helps patients do a virtual consultation and telemedicine through a sister app that will be integrated once the legal system of UAE supports telemedicine.
